results.description:
The Best Seat in Tennis just got better!

Newly upgraded for 2026, Tennis TV is the official live and on-demand online video streaming app of the ATP Tour. Stream live tennis from every ATP Tour tournament, as well as full match replays, classic matches, highlights, draws and live scores as they update in real time. Watch 2,500+ ATP singles and doubles matches each year from every ATP Masters 1000, ATP 500 and ATP 250 tournament, plus the Nitto ATP Finals and Next Gen ATP Finals presented by PIF.

For the first time, enjoy tennis 24/7 on-the-go with our always-on channel, plus all the latest and greatest clips from the Tour with new vertical video Moments and Stories so you never miss a shot.

Get a Premium subscription today and enjoy unlimited access to Tennis TV, including spoiler mode which hides scores and timelines at the tap of a button, or register a free account and enjoy a personalised selection of highlights, hot shots and more.

Features (*new for 2026):
- Live streams from over 55 ATP Tournaments a year, giving uninterrupted access to top-tier tennis throughout the season
- 2,500+ live matches a year, each one available on demand within minutes
- Draws* and order of play featuring scores that update in real-time
- Non-stop action available around the clock with Tennis TV 24/7*
- Improved look and feel, with personalised content tailored for you*
- Scroll through thousands of the best vertical video Moments and Stories from on and off the court*
- Hide timelines and scores with spoiler mode – never have a match ruined again
- Watch how you want with quick highlights, daily compilations, 10-minute match highlights, full-length replays and more
- Dive into over 40,000 hours of full match replays with the Tennis TV library. Enjoy classic matches dating back to 1990 featuring Roger Federer, Rafael Nadal, Novak Djokovic, Andy Murray, Andre Agassi, Pete Sampras and more
- Follow your favourite players and never miss a match
- All ATP Masters 1000s including the BNP Paribas Open (Indian Wells), Miami Open presented by Itau, Rolex Monte-Carlo Masters, Mutua Madrid Open, Internazionali BNL d'Italia (Rome Open), National Bank Open Presented By Rogers, Cincinnati Open, Rolex Shanghai Masters and the Rolex Paris Masters.
- All ATP 500s, ATP 250s plus the prestigious Nitto ATP Finals, Next Gen ATP Finals presented by PIF and the United Cup.

Tennis TV Premium requires a paid subscription. All subscriptions auto-renew, but you can cancel anytime. If you purchase your subscription with in-app payment, you can manage this via your device settings.

Please note that Grand Slams, Davis Cup, Billie Jean King Cup, Laver Cup, WTA matches, ATP 250 outside courts, Challenger Tour matches and qualifiers are not available on Tennis TV. 

Enjoying Tennis TV? Please leave us a review on the App Store.

results.releaseNotes: New: Introducing live activities for your favourite player's live matches. Simply add a favourite player in the app and allow live activities once the match starts to follow scores. In case you don't want to follow the match or want to avoid spoilers, please dismiss the live activity.
